name: Matšoao a kotsi a bokhachane
tagline: Ho tsoa mali, bohloko bo boholo, ha ho na motsamao - nako ea ho kena.
reviewer: Ho hlahloba ha tleliniki ho ntse ho emetse
sources: South African Society of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists

urgent.heading: E-ea sepetlele joale haeba
urgent.primary_message: Matšoao a kotsi a bokhachane a ka bolela phapang lipakeng tsa bophelo le lefu - ho 'm'a kapa lesea. Se eme. U se ke ua hakanya. Eya.
red_flags: Ho tsoa mali a mangata ka botšehaling - ho feta nako e tloaelehileng
Bohloko bo matla ba ka mpeng kapa mokokotlong bo ke keng ba kokobela
Hlooho e bohloko haholo ka pono e lerootho kapa matheba a ho bona
Ho ruruha ho matla ha sefahleho, matsoho kapa maoto ka tšohanyetso
Ngoana ha a sisinyehe joalo ka tloaelo (kamora libeke tse 28)
Ho phatloha ha metsi pele ho libeke tse 37
Ho hlatsa ho ke keng ha emisa

what_is_it.heading: Lebaka leo sena se leng bohlokoa
what_is_it.lede: Ka kakaretso bokhachane bo bolokehile Afrika Boroa, empa mafu a bakhachane a ntse a ata haholo - 'me boholo ba bona bo ka thibeloa. Ho tseba matšoao a kotsi le ho nka khato ka potlako ho pholosa bophelo.
paragraphs: Afrika Boroa e tlaleha mafu a bakhachane a fetang 1,000 selemo se seng le se seng. Tlaleho ea Saving Mothers e bontša hore boholo bo etsahala linthong tse ka thibeloang - ho tsoa mali, khatello e phahameng ea mali, tšoaetso, mathata a maemo a neng a le teng pele. Mafu a mangata a etsahala hobane matšoao a lemosang a ile a tlosoa kapa tlhokomelo e liehile.

Ha ho hlokahale hore u tsebe hore na phoso ke efe. U hloka feela ho hlokomela hore ho na le phoso, 'me u ee sepetlele. Tlhokomelo ea mahala ea pelehi e fumaneha sepetleleng se seng le se seng sa mmuso. Tšepa tlhaho ea hau - haeba ho na le ho hong ho utloang ho fosahetse, mohlomong ho joalo.

facts.heading: Lintho tse 'nè tseo u lokelang ho li tseba

items.body: Basali ba Afrika Boroa ba shoa nakong ea bokhachane kapa pelehi selemo le selemo. Bongata ba mafu ana a ka thibeloa.

items.headline: MomConnect
items.body: Tšehetso ea mahala ea WhatsApp ea bokhachane ho tsoa ho NdoH ka lipuo tsohle tsa SA. Romela 'Hi' ho 079 631 2456 ho ngolisa.

items.headline: Tlhokomelo ea mahala
items.body: Liketelo tsohle tsa bakhachane, pelehi, le tlhokomelo ea tšohanyetso ea pelehi li mahala sepetleleng se seng le se seng sa 'muso le tleliniking.

items.headline: Itšepe
items.body: Haeba ho na le ho hong ho phoso, kena. Basebeletsi ba tsa bophelo bo botle ba ka mpa ba u bona ntle le letho ho e-na le ho fetoa ke ntho e tebileng.

pull_quote.text: Lefu le leng le le leng la bakhachane le na le pale ka mor'a lona ea matšoao a lemosang a fositsoeng kapa a lahliloeng. Haeba u imme 'me u tšoenyehile, karabo e nepahetseng e lokela ho hlahlojoa kamehla. Kamehla.

signs.heading: Matšoao a lemosang ka mokhahlelo oa bokhachane
signs.lede: Matšoao a mang a bohlokoa ka nako efe kapa efe. Tse ling li bohlokoa ho feta ka linako tse ling. Ha u belaela - hlahloba.

items.title: Libeke tse 12 tsa pele
items.description: Ho tsoa mali haholo, mahlaba a bohloko a lehlakoreng le le leng (e ka ba ectopic pregnancy — e behang bophelo kotsing), ho hlatsa ho matla ho thibelang ho theola metsi, feberu e ka holimo ho 38°C.

items.title: Ka mor'a libeke tse 12
items.description: Ho tsoa mali haholo, hlooho e bohloko e nang le liphetoho tsa pono (ho ka etsahala hore ebe preeclampsia), ho ruruha ho matla, ho tsamaea ha lesea butle kapa ho emisa (kamora libeke tse 28).

items.title: Haufi kapa ka nako (kamora libeke tse 37)
items.description: Ho honyela khafetsa, ho phatloha ha metsi, ho tsoa mali, ho fokotseha ha motsamao oa lesea, hlooho e bohloko haholo kapa mahlaba ka mpeng. Se leke ho beha nako ea lintho lapeng - kena.

action_steps.heading: Se o lokelang ho se etsa

items.title: Haeba letšoao la kotsi le hlaha - e-ea sepetlele
items.description: U se ke ua ikhannela haeba u ka e qoba. Letsetsa ambulense kapa motho e mong a u khanne. Nka karete ea hau ea bokhachane kapa buka ea tleliniki.

items.title: U se ke ua leka ho beha nako matšoao lapeng
items.description: Bohloko bo matla, ho tsoa mali, kapa liphetoho tsa pono ha li hloke nako. Kena. Pre-eclampsia le ectopic pregnancy li ka bolaea ka mor'a lihora tse seng kae.

items.title: E-ea sepetleleng seo u se behileng kapa se haufi le uena
items.description: Lipetlele tsa mmuso li tlameha ho amohela maemo a tšohanyetso a bakhachane ho sa tsotelehe hore na u behile hokae. Nka lirekoto tsa hau haeba u na le tsona.

items.title: Haeba o sa tiisehe - molaetsa ho MomConnect
items.description: Ts'ehetso ea mahala ea WhatsApp - romella 'Hi' ho 079 631 2456. Tleliniki ea hau e ka u eletsa hore na u kene. Ha u sa tsebe hantle, khetha sepetlele.

items.title: Eba teng ketelong e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea bakhachane
items.description: Matšoao a mangata a kotsi a bonoa kapele ketelong ea bakhachane. Mahala tleliniking e nngwe le e nngwe. Lenaneo le thibela maemo a tšohanyetso.

get_help.heading: Moo u ka eang teng
get_help.lede: Boemo ba tšohanyetso ba bakhachane bo hloka sepetlele, eseng tleliniki. E-ea sepetleleng sa mmuso se nang le lits'ebeletso tsa pelehi - Tygerberg, Charlotte Maxeke, Steve Biko, King Edward, le ba bang ho potoloha le naha.
